name: Philips Wouwerman

summary.text: Philips Wouwerman was a Dutch painter of hunting, landscape and battle scenes. He became prolific during the Dutch Golden Age and joined the Haarlem Guild of St. Luke.
summary.title: Philips Wouwerman

21614814: The Rider's Halting Place is a painting by the Dutch Golden Age painter Philips Wouwerman, active between 1639 and his death in 1668. He was a prolific painter of scenes with horses and riders in a landscape, such as this one.
